title: Innistrad: Crimson Vow: card flavor text

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who weds to unite the bloodlines, issues invitations, entertains with hunted villagers and exacts blood tithes.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who tears free from bindings and summons her Host of Herons; her Sect travels spreading hope.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A cathar leader who vows to cleanse Thraben and speaks against Olivia.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire who questions whether Olivia's wedding ceremony is a mockery or sincere.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker whose rescue of Berit's village showed vampires could be killed.

entities.name: Berit
entities.description: A villager who, after Kaya saved her village, found her calling as a vampire slayer.

entities.name: Anders
entities.description: A cathar drillmaster who teaches gryff riding.

entities.name: Adin
entities.description: A Moorland villager who hopes the Gavony Riders will save them.

entities.name: Gregel
entities.description: A militia leader who feels watched after escaping.

entities.name: Val
entities.description: A woman offered something by a silent geist.

entities.name: Lorn
entities.description: A Lambholt innkeeper bothered by a catgeist.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A necro-alchemist whose laboratory notes praise Geralf and who orders Garl to chase off a drake.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher who shows his sister a horror inspired by her.

entities.name: Garl
entities.description: A stitcher's assistant who forgets anatomy and chases away drakes.

entities.name: Barton
entities.description: A stitcher who does not care whether parts match.

entities.name: Jacob Hauken
entities.description: An inspector who sees plenty to see in a dark world.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire who warns an alchemist away from the sea's secrets and offers immortality.

entities.name: Lord Krothuss
entities.description: A lord whose mercy Runo Stromkirk promises will not come twice.

entities.name: York
entities.description: A Kessig tracker who hopes crows are not an omen.

entities.name: Beltstad
entities.description: A cathar recruit who panics in his last words.

entities.name: Halana
entities.description: A Kessig ranger who comments to Alena and wants to follow an Ulvenwald oddity.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: A Kessig trapper who urges running from the Ulvenwald Behemoth.

entities.name: Anje Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire who tells a child to wipe their chin so Olivia does not think them uncivilized.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon who offers power at a price.

entities.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who mocks a ghoul.

entities.name: Tinua
entities.description: A Skirsdag cultist who knows the new by their screaming.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A vampire-hunter who resists a vampire's curse but is doomed to become a monster.

entities.name: Kerren
entities.description: A Mausoleum Guards instructor who explains why mass graves are not used.

entities.name: Marel
entities.description: A Dawnhart witch who speaks of molding change and sharing enemies with the woods.

entities.name: Higa
entities.description: The slayer-captain of Gatstaf who brings party favors.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: A fiendslayer who says devils reap chaos as their reward.

entities.name: Rahilda
entities.description: The Vildin-Pack alpha who says the wilds show lost souls who they are.

entities.name: Ralen
entities.description: A man who shows off hunter's fire.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: An Order of Saint Traft member who brings the Blessed Sleep to the dead.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker who objects to the Voldaren-Markov union and would welcome a pack member with honor.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A speaker who praises the forests' assertiveness and seeds waiting for the sun.

entities.name: Nesmith
entities.description: A mariner who lost his hands, rumored to a werewolf.

entities.name: Vesna
entities.description: A Dawnhart witch who calls for celebrating lives rather than mourning.

entities.name: Yaster
entities.description: A Havengul shopkeeper who flees a looming threat.

entities.name: Old Rutstein
entities.description: A chest-hunter who avoids a fungus and scorpion venom.

entities.name: Ryla
entities.description: A woman who lost her appetite after the ritual.

entities.name: Cosper Lowe
entities.description: A member of the Silbern Guard who recommends sturdy nails.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: The Dawnhart Prime who says not to miss the world's beauty.

entities.name: Tamil
entities.description: A man who studies a geist's lantern in death.

entities.name: Harold
entities.description: A man called a coward for running from wolves.

entities.name: Arvon
entities.description: A man eager to give blood to a captivating creature.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A werewolf leader whose howlpack has scattered.

entities.name: Dorothea
entities.description: A victim who cannot rest while a Voldaren lives.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: A vampire groom whose gift has been taken for granted.

entities.name: Eruth
entities.description: A prophet cursed with true visions.

entities.name: Ivold
entities.description: A man aghast at the scope of the geist infestation.

entities.name: Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire bloodline with a fortress lit by geists, torture pits and blood tithes.

entities.name: Markov
entities.description: A vampire bloodline in union with the Voldaren.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire line descended from a falconer.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire bloodline.

entities.name: Dawnhart
entities.description: A coven finding strength in nature and serving communities.

entities.name: Quietus Cult
entities.description: A cult seeking wisdom from the dead.

entities.name: Skirsdag cult
entities.description: A demon-worshiping cult.

entities.name: Sigardian Sect
entities.description: Priests who spread hope and healing.

entities.description: Innistrad's holy defenders.

entities.name: Quiver of Kessig
entities.description: An order of cathars specializing in ranged combat.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: An order whose member brings the Blessed Sleep.

entities.name: Mausoleum Guards
entities.description: Guards who work with the dead.

entities.name: Silbern Guard
entities.description: A guard of which Cosper Lowe is a member.

entities.name: Vildin-Pack
entities.description: A werewolf pack led by Rahilda.

entities.name: Dire-Strain
entities.description: Survivors of Tovolar's pack still hunting.

entities.name: Runechanters
entities.description: Repairers of twisted symbols of Avacyn.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel whose symbols the Church restores after the Travails.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane of the wedding and eternal night.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city where ghouls are the only abundant resource.

entities.name: Lurenbraum Fortress
entities.description: The Voldaren fortress hosting the wedding in the Crimson Ballroom.

entities.name: Crimson Ballroom
entities.description: The wedding ballroom that receives unexpected guests.

entities.name: Moorlands
entities.description: A land protected by a Drogskol soldier.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A region whose people rekindle their will to fight at dawn.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region where being alone is most dangerous.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region whose tides obey the moon.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: A forest where old powers stir.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: A town whose slayer-captain is Higa.

entities.name: Geier Reach
entities.description: Mountain passes where howling is heard.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: A town home to shopkeeper Yaster.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: A village with an innkeeper named Lorn.

entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: A town with a skaab that entombs bodies.

entities.name: the Malignus
entities.description: A fire that a door survived.

entities.name: the Travails
entities.description: A calamity after which Avacyn's symbols were repaired.

entities.name: Harvesttide tragedy
entities.description: A tragedy whose memories became an incarnate rage.

entities.name: Blessed Sleep
entities.description: The rest of the dead.

events.summary: Olivia forbids entry without a red-envelope invitation to Lurenbraum.
events.quote: Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.

events.summary: Dawnhart geists hope to complete their ritual even in death.
events.quote: Our bodies may lie slain, but perhaps we can still complete the ritual.

events.summary: A soldier swears to protect the Moorlands even beyond death.
events.quote: He swore to protect the Moorlands.

events.summary: A shieldbasher's door survives the fires of the Malignus.
events.quote: The door to her home survived the fires of the Malignus.

events.summary: Anders coaches a cathar gryff rider.
events.quote: Keep your heels down and bend at the hips as your mount takes flight.

events.summary: Parish-Blade recruits train in eternal night, hoping to see the sun.
events.quote: The recruits trained in eternal night, fueled by the hope that they might one day see the sun again.

events.summary: Thalia says creatures of night dissolve in faith's light.
events.quote: Creatures of the night dissolve like shadows in the light of faith.

events.summary: Olivia expects defiance but not an armed resistance.
events.quote: It's not that I didn't expect some defiance, but I did hope it wouldn't be so heavily armed.

events.summary: Thalia states that Olivia has faith only in herself.
events.quote: Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling.

events.summary: Thalia vows to cleanse Thraben.
events.quote: I will not rest until it is cleansed.

events.summary: Sigardian Sect priests travel to spread hope and healing.
events.quote: Priests of the Sigardian Sect travel to the farthest reaches to spread hope and healing, even in the darkest times.

events.summary: A woman dies facing down a howlpack and saves her town.
events.quote: She faced down a howlpack alone, saving her town at the cost of her life.

events.summary: Sorin questions whether Olivia has fallen for her own charade at the wedding.
events.quote: Is this twisted ceremony simply a mockery of the human rite, or has Olivia fallen for her own charade?

events.summary: Kaya saves Berit's village, and Berit becomes a vampire slayer.
events.quote: When Kaya saved her village, Berit realized even vampires could be killed.

events.summary: Wedding guests are met with a pageant of wealth.
events.quote: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

events.summary: Adin hopes the Gavony Riders will rescue villagers.
events.quote: I hear hoofbeats! The Gavony Riders are coming to save us!

events.summary: Gregel escaped yet feels watched.
events.quote: I escaped, so why do I still feel like I'm being watched?

events.summary: Geralf shows off a horror inspired by his sister.
events.quote: Do you like it, Sister? Its dreadful visage was inspired by your own.

events.summary: Ludevic notes Geralf's growing prowess.
events.quote: Geralf's prowess continues to grow.

events.summary: Barton states he does not want matching parts.
events.quote: If I wanted all the parts to match, I wouldn't have become a stitcher.

events.summary: Ludevic orders Garl to chase off a drake.
events.quote: Blasted drake's interfering with the conductivity again. Garl! Go chase it away.

events.summary: Runo Stromkirk warns an alchemist away from the sea's secrets.
events.quote: This is your only warning, alchemist.

events.summary: Geists light the Voldaren fortress as they seek a way out.
events.quote: The towers and catwalks of the Voldaren fortress are lit by the lanterns of geists endlessly seeking a way out.

events.summary: Ivold is aghast at the geist infestation.
events.quote: Ivold was aghast when his device revealed the full scope of the geist infestation.

events.summary: Beltstad panics in his last words.
events.quote: Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!

events.summary: Anje tells a child to wipe their chin to avoid displeasing Olivia.
events.quote: Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized.

events.summary: Ghouls are the only abundant resource in Thraben.
events.quote: These days, ghouls are the only abundant resource in Thraben.

events.summary: Bats carry wedding invitations from Lurenbraum Fortress to vampires of every bloodline.
events.quote: Swarms of bats poured from Lurenbraum Fortress carrying wedding invitations to vampires of every bloodline.

events.summary: Ormendahl offers power for a price.
events.quote: You want power? This is the price.

events.summary: Gisa mocks a ghoul's brains.
events.quote: This still doesn't make you the brains of the operation.

events.summary: Tinua quips that new cultists scream.
events.quote: You can always tell who's new from the screaming.

events.summary: Odric resists a vampire's curse but is doomed to become a monster.
events.quote: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength.

events.summary: Olivia sets villagers loose in the hedge maze as entertainment.
events.quote: Olivia set a few villagers loose in the hedge maze as part of the evening's "entertainment."

events.summary: Kerren explains why mass graves are no longer used.
events.quote: In case any of you new recruits were wondering, this is why we don't use mass graves anymore.

events.summary: Wedding security is paid with permission to devour intruders.
events.quote: In lieu of payment, he was granted permission to devour any unauthorized visitors.

events.summary: Arvon offers his blood to a captivating creature.
events.quote: Arvon was ecstatic to offer his blood to such a captivating creature.

events.summary: Stensia's people rekindle their will to fight at a glimpse of dawn.
events.quote: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

events.summary: Unexpected guests arrive in the Crimson Ballroom when Lurenbraum's defenses falter.
events.quote: When the defenses around Lurenbraum Fortress faltered, the Crimson Ballroom received some unexpected guests.

events.summary: Harold flees wolves and is called a coward, but at nightfall others flee.
events.quote: When Harold ran from the wolves, the others called him a coward.

events.summary: Higa brings her own party favors to the wedding.
events.quote: I noticed you were short on party favors, so I brought my own.

events.summary: Rahilda describes how the wilds reveal lost souls.
events.quote: When lost souls wander into the woods, the wilds have a way of showing them who they really are.

events.summary: Grete says it is the duty to bring the Blessed Sleep to the dead.
events.quote: It is our duty to bring the Blessed Sleep to the dead, even if they resist that gift.

events.summary: Arlinn voices her opinion before the Voldaren-Markov union can proceed.
events.quote: Arlinn made her opinion known.

events.summary: Olivia makes an example of villages that refuse her blood tithe.
events.quote: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.

events.summary: Wrenn notes the forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves.
events.quote: The forests of this world are unafraid to assert themselves.

events.summary: Old powers stir in the Ulvenwald as day and night twist.
events.quote: As the natural cycle of day and night grew twisted, old powers stirred deep in the Ulvenwald.

events.summary: A long-slumbering force rises to protect its home, far from the wedding.
events.quote: a long-slumbering force arose to protect its home.

events.summary: Arlinn would welcome a worthy wolf into her pack.
events.quote: I would welcome her into my pack with honor.

events.summary: Vesna says to celebrate the lives of the dead.
events.quote: We are here to celebrate their lives.

events.summary: Halana warns Alena of quiet clearings.
events.quote: Tread carefully. You remember what happened in the last quiet, peaceful clearing.

events.summary: Marel notes that the Dawnhart and the woods share enemies.
events.quote: We're not at odds with the woods. How could we be, when we share so many enemies?

events.summary: Tovolar's howlpack scatters but the Dire-Strain survivors still hunt.
events.quote: Tovolar's howlpack had scattered, but the Dire-Strain survivors were still on the hunt.

events.summary: A wolfkin outcast finds family only in the wilds.
events.quote: Only in the wilds did he find a family that accepted him.

events.summary: Olivia's wedding aims to unite the vampire bloodlines.
events.quote: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

events.summary: Olivia offers servants as refreshments.
events.quote: Please, my friends, help yourselves to the help.

events.summary: Cosper Lowe recommends sturdy nails for sound sleep.
events.quote: Sturdy nails make for sound sleep.

events.summary: Runechanters repair twisted symbols of Avacyn after the Travails.
events.quote: After the Travails, Runechanters set about repairing twisted symbols of Avacyn as the first step in restoring faith in the Church.

events.summary: Katilda urges seeing the world's beauty amid searching for evil.
events.quote: Spend too much time scanning the shadows for evil and you'll never see the beauty our world has to offer.

events.summary: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda breaks free and summons her Host of Herons.
events.quote: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

events.summary: Tamil spends eternity studying a geist's lantern.
events.quote: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern.

events.summary: Dorothea says she cannot rest while a Voldaren lives.
events.quote: Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest.

events.summary: Edgar resolves to correct his kind's neglect of his gift.
events.quote: Our kind has taken my gift for granted. It is time to correct that folly.

events.summary: Eruth's visions of monsters and suffering all come true.
events.quote: She is cursed with visions of monsters and suffering . . . and all her visions come true.

events.summary: Edgar's ceremonial incense is a blend of blood from his favorite human lineages.
events.quote: The ceremonial "incense" was a concoction of Edgar's own design, a precise blend of blood from his favorite human lineages.

events.summary: A Markov vampire insists on leading the waltz.
events.quote: I'll lead.

events.summary: Edgar is woken for his own wedding.
events.quote: Can't have you sleeping through your own wedding day.

events.summary: Runo Stromkirk offers immortality as a blessing.
events.quote: You are one of the few to whom we offer our blessing. What fool would reject immortality?

relations.quote: Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling.

relations.note: Sigarda breaks free while Olivia is distracted.
relations.quote: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

relations.note: Olivia seeks to rule the unified bloodlines.
relations.quote: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

relations.note: Kaya saved Berit's village and inspired her.
relations.quote: When Kaya saved her village, Berit realized even vampires could be killed.

relations.note: Ludevic's notes say Geralf can replicate his creations.
relations.quote: He can now replicate my own creations with near-perfect accuracy.

relations.note: Ludevic gives orders to Garl, his assistant.
Dorothea cannot rest while a Voldaren lives.
relations.quote: Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest.
Spend too much time scanning the shadows for evil and you'll never see the beauty our world has to offer.
You can always tell who's new from the screaming.
Wipe your chin, child. We can't have Olivia thinking we're uncivilized.

relations.note: Cosper is of the Silbern Guard.
relations.quote: Sturdy nails make for sound sleep.
When lost souls wander into the woods, the wilds have a way of showing them who they really are.
We're not at odds with the woods. How could we be, when we share so many enemies?

relations.note: The survivors continue the hunt after Tovolar's howlpack scattered.
relations.quote: Tovolar's howlpack had scattered, but the Dire-Strain survivors were still on the hunt.
